name: Coastal Plain Goldentop
desc: Coastal Plain Goldentop (Euthamia caroliniana): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euthamia caroliniana, known as Carolina grass-leaved goldenrod or slender goldentop is a flowering plant in the genus Euthamia, a member of the family Asteraceae.
